_comment: Single source of truth for the count-claims that appear in README*.md and docs/. CI / pre-push runs verification/check_count_claims.py, which re-measures these from the actual repo and fails on drift. Update with `python verification/check_count_claims.py --update` (then refresh the doc prose it points at). See ADRs/count-claim-drift-guard-2026-05-31.md.

lean._note: Deterministic (grep over lean/). HARD-gated: a mismatch fails the guard. This is the drift that actually happened (docs said 50 when reality was 71).

pytest._note: Collected counts grow as tests are added. SOFT-banded: the guard fails only on OVER-claim (a doc number greater than reality, i.e. a lie) and warns on stale-low. Refresh with --update when convenient.

doc_presence._note: Each value must appear literally in the named file, so the human-facing prose cannot silently diverge from this manifest.
